retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, expressionist portrait fragmented by geometric prismatic overlays and horizontal strikethrough typography.
triggerTerms: vibrant oil painting with light leaks
excludeWhen: traditional black and white portraits are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait rendered in a heavy, expressive oil painting style, intersected by sharp geometric wedges and vertical color bands that shift the hue and saturation of the underlying image. The composition is unified by a thin circular line and features right-aligned text with a continuous horizontal line cutting through each word.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric shards acting as color-shifting filters over the portrait
Vertical paint drips and light streaks contrasting with sharp circular geometry
Right-aligned typography integrated with horizontal strikethrough lines
High-contrast interplay between warm yellows/reds and cool blues/purples
coreInvariants: A thin white circular outline framing the central facial features
Horizontal lines that pass through the center of every text character
Visible impasto and brushstroke textures throughout the portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale profile portrait facing left, occupying the central and left-middle thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eye of the subject, positioned at the intersection of several geometric wedges.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular white line around the face, then moves right toward the stacked text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with atmospheric color washes and textured brushwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Magenta and Red (Background and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Cerulean and Navy (Shadows and geometric shifts)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Yellow and Cyan (Light leaks and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across the entire spectrum with deep value contrasts in the facial shadows.

letterConstructionRules: A single continuous horizontal line bisects every character in a line of text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' lacks a traditional crossbar, replaced by the global strikethrough line
The letter 'H' crossbar is aligned perfectly with the strikethrough
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying line lengths.

candidateDirections.reason: Open counters and clean geometric structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an expressionist oil painting of a profile portrait with heavy brushstrokes, vibrant reds, yellows, and blues. Overlay sharp geometric triangular wedges that shift the color of the portrait underneath. Add a thin white circular line around the face and vertical paint drips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned uppercase geometric sans-serif text. For each line of text, draw a single horizontal white line that passes through the exact vertical center of all characters.

verificationChecks: Does a horizontal line bisect every character?
Is the portrait style painterly with visible texture?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific celebrity likenesses
Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure the strikethrough is a clean geometric line, not a hand-drawn scratch

mustAchieve: Complex layering of color and texture
Sharp geometric precision in the overlays

postGenerationChecks: Check that the circular line is a perfect geometric arc
Verify that the color shifts occur exactly at the edges of the geometric shards
Ensure the text is perfectly right-aligned
Confirm the oil paint texture is visible in the highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Expressionist Portrait + Geometric Prisms + Strikethrough Typography
